races.title: Lisa Margaret Turner Memorial Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Last-time-out winners FAIRLAWN SKIPPER and Walk In The Valley remain low-mileage chasers who are going the right way and rate the pair to focus on. The former narrowly preferred dropped back in trip following his solid fourth in a stronger handicap at Cheltenham. FAIRLAWN SKIPPER WALK IN THE VALLEY (IRE) GLORY AND HONOUR (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Walk In The Valley (6/4), Fairlawn Skipper (13/8), Glory And Honour (11/4)

races.title: Paxtons Northallerton Parts Team Power Performance Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: IN THE TRENCHES has made a sound start over fences for his new yard and he looks to have been found an excellent opportunity back over hurdles despite conceding weight all round. Multiple point scorer Farfromaway can provide chief resistance with this increase in trip promising to see him in a better light. IN THE TRENCHES FARFROMAWAY (IRE) ARCIMBOLDO

races.title: Sedgefield Christmas Jumper Raceday 22nd December Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Unexposed stayer FRISKY WHISKEY can follow up her Hexham success. Jeteye is enjoying a fine year and appeals as the most likely danger. FRISKY WHISKEY JETEYE (IRE) WEE ALKI (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Frisky Whiskey (13/8), Jeteye (15/8), Wee Alki (3/1), Last Man D'arcy (12/1), Simiyann (16/1)

races.title: Christmas Parties At Sedgefield Racecourse Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: This could be a good opportunity for serial runner-up MILITARY CROSS to get his head in front. Fairly useful bumper performer Close House rates the chief danger following a breathing operation, with fellow hurdling debutant Carthusian also commanding respect. MILITARY CROSS (IRE) CLOSE HOUSE (IRE) CARTHUSIAN (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Close House (6/4), Military Cross (11/4), Carthusian (5/1), Champagne Powder (15/2), Mac's Max (8/1), Who's The Goat (16/1), Get On Son (33/1)

races.title: Paxtons Pity Me Workshop Top Peformance Novices' Handicap Chase
races.verdict: SOLDIER IN MAYO has run well on 2 of 3 starts over fences and appeals as the most likely winner in a thin race. Brave Move and Alidam are potential dangers, the latter worth noting in the betting for new connections. SOLDIER IN MAYO (IRE) BRAVE MOVE (IRE) ALIDAM (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Soldier In Mayo (10/11), Brave Move (10/3), Knacker Trapper (7/2), Mr Globalist (12/1), Alidam (20/1)

races.title: Catertech North East Ltd Mares' Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Having finished second in a race that worked out well at Newcastle in the spring, MIDNIGHT BELLA didn't get the chance to show what she could do following a breathing operation/8 months off when unseating mid-race in a course novice 10 days ago. A low-mileage mare, she's well worth another chance back in a handicap over this slightly longer trip. Stellarmasterpiece has enjoyed a highly productive 2026 under both codes and is fancied to play a lead role once more. MIDNIGHT BELLA STELLARMASTERPIECE (FR) LEAVE HER TO ME
races.bettingForecast: Stellarmasterpiece (13/8), Midnight Bella (15/8), Strathcatcha (4/1), Eremenko (12/1), Leave Her To Me (12/1), Khaleesi Queen (25/1)
